local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "TraitDebuggerConfig.json"

local function saveSettings(data)
	local jsonString = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	
	if writefile then
		pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME, jsonString) end)
	end
	
	pcall(function()
		TeleportService:SetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig", jsonString)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings()
	local rawData = nil
	
	if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) then
		pcall(function() rawData = readfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) end)
	end
	
	if not rawData then
		pcall(function() rawData = TeleportService:GetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig") end)
	end
	
	if rawData then
		local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawData) end)
		if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local workbenchEspEnabled = true
local WORKBENCH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
local WORKBENCH_HL_NAME = "WorkbenchESP"
local leaderboardVisible = true

local function setLeaderboardState(state)
	leaderboardVisible = state
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, leaderboardVisible)
	end)
end

local function purgeCustomLeaderboards()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end
	local commonLeaderboardNames = {"leaderboard", "playerlist", "tabmenu", "scoreboard"}
	for _, ui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		local lowerName = string.lower(ui.Name)
		for _, targetName in ipairs(commonLeaderboardNames) do
			if string.find(lowerName, targetName) then
				ui:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if not leaderboardVisible then purgeCustomLeaderboards() end
end)

local function clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Highlight") and desc.Name == WORKBENCH_HL_NAME then
			desc:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function applyWorkbenchHighlight(obj)
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	if obj.Name == "Workbench" and not obj:FindFirstChild(WORKBENCH_HL_NAME) then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = WORKBENCH_HL_NAME
		hl.Adornee = obj
		hl.FillColor = WORKBENCH_COLOR
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = obj
	end
end

local function refreshWorkbenchESP()
	clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc.Name == "Workbench" then
		task.wait(0.1)
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)

end)

		for traitId, state in pairs(loadedConfig.traits) do

		end

	if loadedConfig.workbenchEsp ~= nil then workbenchEspEnabled = loadedConfig.workbenchEsp end
	if loadedConfig.leaderboard ~= nil then leaderboardVisible = loadedConfig.leaderboard end
	if loadedConfig.uiPosition then savedUiPosition = loadedConfig.uiPosition end
	if loadedConfig.uiVisible ~= nil then savedUiVisible = loadedConfig.uiVisible end
end

	local pos = mainFrame and mainFrame.Position or UDim2.new(savedUiPosition.XScale, savedUiPosition.XOffset, savedUiPosition.YScale, savedUiPosition.YOffset)
	local isVis = mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible or savedUiVisible

	saveSettings({
		traits = savedTraits,
		workbenchEsp = workbenchEspEnabled,
		leaderboard = leaderboardVisible,
		uiPosition = {
			XScale = pos.X.Scale,
			XOffset = pos.X.Offset,
			YScale = pos.Y.Scale,
			YOffset = pos.Y.Offset
		},
		uiVisible = isVis
	})

local traitUI = {}
local layoutCounter = 0

local function updateUI()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	local allTraitsActive = true

	for traitId, uiGroup in pairs(traitUI) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existsInGame = perksFolder and perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)
		local isActive = savedTraits[traitId] or (existsInGame ~= nil)

		if isActive then
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 50, 38)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 120, 75)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "ACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
		else
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "INACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
			allTraitsActive = false
		end
	end

	if allTraitsActive then
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "DISABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 32, 32)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 120, 120)
	else
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "ENABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
	end
end

local function applyStateToFolder()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	if not perksFolder then return false end

	local noneVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild("trait:none")
	if noneVal then noneVal:Destroy() end

	for traitId, isEnabled in pairs(savedTraits) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existingVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)

		if isEnabled and not existingVal then
			local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			boolVal.Name = valueName
			boolVal.Value = false
			boolVal.Parent = perksFolder
		elseif not isEnabled and existingVal then
			existingVal:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true
end

		badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		badge.TextSize = 10
		badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		badge.Parent = card

		traitUI[traitId] = {Card = card, Stroke = cardStroke, Badge = badge}

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			savedTraits[traitId] = not savedTraits[traitId]
			applyStateToFolder()
			updateUI()
			persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
		end)
	end
end

toggleAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	local targetState = false
	for traitId, state in pairs(savedTraits) do
		if not state then
			targetState = true
			break
		end
	end

	for traitId in pairs(savedTraits) do
		savedTraits[traitId] = targetState
	end

	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

wbToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	workbenchEspEnabled = not workbenchEspEnabled
	wbToggleBtn.Text = workbenchEspEnabled and "WORKBENCH ESP: ON" or "WORKBENCH ESP: OFF"
	wbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = workbenchEspEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	refreshWorkbenchESP()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)

	setLeaderboardState(not leaderboardVisible)
	lbToggleBtn.Text = leaderboardVisible and "LEADERBOARD: ON" or "LEADERBOARD: OFF"
	lbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = leaderboardVisible and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

local function hookPerks(perks)
	perks.ChildAdded:Connect(updateUI)
	perks.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateUI)
	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
end

local function watchCharacter(char)
	if not char then return end
	local existingPerks = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if existingPerks then
		hookPerks(existingPerks)
	end
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "perks" then
			hookPerks(child)
		end
	end)
	applyStateToFolder()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local applied = applyStateToFolder()
		updateUI()
		if applied then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local function setupWatcher()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:WaitForChild("activePlayers", 15)
	if not activePlayers then return end

	activePlayers.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
			watchCharacter(child)
		end
	end)

	local existingChar = activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
	if existingChar then
		watchCharacter(existingChar)
	end
end

setupWatcher()
refreshWorkbenchESP()
setLeaderboardState(leaderboardVisible)
updateUI()

-- variables
local inter = workspace:FindFirstChild("Interactables")
local scavs = workspace:FindFirstChild("activeHostiles")
local uip = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- functions

local function addEsp(item, clr)
    if item then
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
        h.Name = "ESP"
        h.Parent = item
        h.FillColor = clr
        h.OutlineColor = clr
    end
end

local function disableEsp(item)
    if item then
        local esp = item:FindFirstChild("ESP")
        if esp then
            esp.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

local function refreshEsp()
    for _, item in inter:GetChildren() do
        if item then
            if not item:FindFirstChild("ESP") then
                if item.Name == "Workbench" then
                    addEsp(item, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
                elseif item.Name == "Long Ammo" or item.Name == "Medium Ammo" or item.Name == "Small Ammo" or item.Name == "Short Ammo" or     item.Name == "Heavy Ammo" or item.Name == "Shells Ammo" or item.Name == "Light Ammo" then
                    addEsp(item, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0))
                elseif item.Name == "Locker" or item.Name == "Double Locker" or item.Name == "Medical Cabinet" then
                    addEsp(item, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255))
                elseif item.Name == "Scapper" then
                    addEsp(item, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
                else
                    addEsp(item, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
                end
            else
                if item.Name == "Locker" or item.Name == "Double Locker" or item.Name == "Medical Cabinet" then
                    if item:FindFirstChild("stats") then
                        if item.stats:FindFirstChild("interactable") then
                            if item.stats:FindFirstChild("interactable").Value == false then
                                if item:FindFirstChild("ESP") then 
                                    disableEsp(item)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
